q: What if an EU importer buys the same steel from two plants of one supplier?
title: One supplier, two plants: CBAM data
short: Embedded emissions are worked out per installation, so the importer needs a separate figure for each plant that made the goods, even when the supplier, product and invoice look the same. Ask the supplier to name the installation on every shipment and to send per-installation data.
audience: EU importers buying steel or aluminium from suppliers with several plants, for example in Indian, Turkish or Vietnamese clusters

p: CBAM ties embedded emissions to the installation where the good was produced. Two plants with different routes or fuels can give very different figures for the same CN code.

ul: The installation that produced each consignment.
Embedded emissions per tonne for that installation and period.
Which plant supplied which share, when one shipment mixes production.

sections.h: If the supplier cannot split it
p: Without per-installation data, the importer may have to use default values for the part it cannot attribute. Agree the split in the supply contract.
